payload.name: plan
payload.description: A short plan naming the relevant columns/rows and operation.

payload.name: evidence
payload.description: The relevant table facts used by the plan.

payload.name: operation
payload.description: The compact table operation used to compute or select the answer.

payload.name: answer
payload.description: Return the final answer as a JSON array of strings. For one answer, return a one-element array. Preserve complete table-cell values.

payload.content: Fill `plan`, `evidence`, and `operation` before the final answer. Keep each field concise and make `answer` the only field used for the final denotation.
Return only the fields shown in the output format instructions. Keep intermediate reasoning in the reasoning/workpad field(s), and keep the final result in the final output field.

rationale: Visible reasoning scaffold for hitab; pair with private reasoning rules to make reasoning behavior observable without changing the aligned private-rule taxonomy.
